biotools.summary: gymnoTOA-db is a relational database and accompanying application designed to facilitate functional annotation in gymnosperms. It provides a non-redundant dataset of gymnosperm proteins and a pipeline for high-throughput sequencing-derived DNA or cDNA sequence annotation.
